name: Geopolymer Paving at SIJ Acroni
zag_role: Demonstration of alkali activated paving blocks
description: On 24 April 2024 ZAG presented geopolymerisation technology within the GEORIS project. KU Leuven brought a mobile unit and demonstrated production of paving blocks by the geopolymer process, and participants then viewed paving blocks already laid at the SIJ Acroni headquarters. SIJ Acroni reported on 25 April 2024 that the bicycle area in front of the steelworks building was paved with these blocks.
